purpose: High-priority 14-image plant-part mismatch batch, extracted from verified image registry for parallel remediation.
quality_gates: Confirm correct botanical taxon and explicitly named plant part.
Verify replacement image is reachable and accurately depicts intended part.
Preserve image license, attribution, source URL and license URL.
Do not auto-replace images until a candidate passes all gates.
Avoid changing published feeding verdicts or nutrition data.
